items.author: Greg Lindqvist
items.title: Deschutes trip, the fish won again
items.body: Me and Lars drove out to Maupin for three days. Caught exactly two trout, one of which Lars swears was his. Weather was perfect though. Pictures below, the one of the canyon at sunset is the best one, Tessa feel free to critique. Already planning next year.

items.author: Karen Lindqvist
items.title: Thanksgiving at Ruthie's! Who's bringing what
items.body: Hi everyone! Thanksgiving is Thursday Nov 26 at Ruthie's house in Salem, dinner at 3. Ruthie is doing the turkey, I'm doing stuffing and the green bean thing. Please comment with what you're bringing so we don't end up with five pies again (ok five pies was fine). Tessa are you bringing Sam? Love, Mom

items.author: Tessa Lindqvist
items.title: Wedding season is EATING me alive (in a good way)
items.body: Quick update from the trenches! Seven weddings in five weekends for Rosebud Lane, my knees are done, my camera has more miles on it than my car. Best one was a barn wedding in Hood River where the flower girl tried to steal my lens cap and almost got away with it. Love you all, see you at Labor Day.

items.author: Dennis Lindqvist
items.title: Comment on: Wedding season is EATING me alive
items.body: Proud of you kiddo. Still think you ought to look at that school portrait outfit Bree mentioned. Steady hours, health insurance, no knees involved. Just saying. Dad

items.author: marisol@rosebudlanestudio.example
items.title: Rosebud Lane news, please read
items.body: Tessa, I wanted you to hear this from me before anyone else. I'm closing Rosebud Lane at the end of October. It's not about the work and it's definitely not about you. I'm going to refer every 2027 couple I can't keep to you, I already told six of them you're the one. You're ready, honestly you've been ready for two years. Call me. Marisol

items.author: marisol@rosebudlanestudio.example
items.title: the real reason, just between us
items.body: Since you asked. Please keep this to yourself, I mean it. Rick's sports betting thing got way worse than I knew and he emptied the studio account, I found out when the lease payment bounced. With the divorce stuff on top of it I can't keep it open. I haven't told my own mother yet. Not even Sam, ok?

items.author: tessa@fernhollowphoto.example
items.title: Fernhollow 2027 numbers
items.body: LLC filed Oct 22, Fernhollow Photo LLC. Website live Nov 1. 14 weddings booked for 2027 (6 from Marisol referrals, 8 mine). Deposits in so far: $9,800. Busiest month June, 4 weddings. Furthest out: Wallowa Lake in Sept. Health insurance: picked a marketplace plan Nov 5, starts Jan 1. Second shooter for big ones: Jae, paid per wedding.

items.author: tessa@fernhollowphoto.example
items.title: real budget - me and Sam only
items.body: NOT for family. Checking after the second Z body + lenses: $1,740. Sam covering rent Dec + Jan. Credit card at $6,300. If spring inquiries are slow I pick up shifts at Sam's cousin's print shop. Do not tell Mom about the card.

items.author: dahlia.okoro@mailbox.example
items.title: We're in!! June 12 at Timberline
items.body: Hi Tessa! Ken and I talked it over and we want you for June 12. Deposit is sent. We loved the photos you did for Marisol's couple at Multnomah Falls, that's what sold us. Can't wait. Dahlia

items.author: Bree Lindqvist-Shaw
items.title: Meet Juniper!
items.body: She's here! Juniper Rose, 7 lbs 4 oz, born Oct 27 at 4:12am. Everyone is healthy and tired. Thank you for all the meals, Aunt Karen your lasagna saved us. Visitors welcome after Thanksgiving, please wash your hands a lot.

items.author: deals@pdxcameraexchange.example
items.title: Holiday trade-in event starts Friday
items.body: Bring in your old gear this weekend and get 15% extra trade-in credit toward any mirrorless body or lens. Store hours 10 to 6 on Hawthorne.

items.author: tessa@fernhollowphoto.example
items.title: Thanksgiving at Ruthie's, Salem
items.body: Bring: rolls + the cranberry thing. Sam driving. Leave by 1:45.
